posts.title: A Pinned Note
posts.text: This post is older than “Hello World” but has top: true, so it floats to the very top of the home list — even across pagination. Pinning is a convention: add top: true to a post’s front-matter. It maps onto Hexo’s built-in sticky sort, which runs before pagination.
